title: Turn every call into revenue — guaranteed lift on the metrics that matter.
lead: Our in-house call center doesn't just dial numbers — it engineers outcomes. Trained agents confirm, upsell and rescue orders in real time, so more parcels get accepted, fewer come back, and each basket is worth more.
bullets: Higher delivery success — proactive confirmation calls raise accepted-parcel rate on COD and courier orders.
Fewer returns — expectation-setting and objection handling before the parcel ships cut the return ratio.
Bigger Average Order Value — scripted upsell and cross-sell add proven margin to every basket.
More total turnover — combined lift on conversion, AOV and delivery rate compounds into measurable revenue growth.
Transparent per-campaign reporting on every KPI above, tied to your CRM.
